A sign-in, registration or password screen

Several CRUD screens at once, or a bespoke workflow

ui-page.index.summary: A CRUDDY index controller passes a typed ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Index/Page.vue.

ui-page.show.summary: A show method passes one record's ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Show/Page.vue; dates render with the kit RelativeTime component.

ui-page.form.summary: create/store or edit/update methods, a FormRequest, an Action for the write and a toast on the redirect.

ui-page.add-button.summary: Add, New and Create buttons are kit Buttons carrying the Plus icon.

ui-page.external-link.summary: target=_blank links carry rel=noopener and the external-link icon.

ui-page.action-menu.summary: Action menus run actions only. Navigation goes in links or tabs, never in an action menu, and nothing hand-rolls a kit primitive.

ui-page.upload.summary: File inputs only come from the kit dropzone component inside a form page.

ui-page.data-table.summary: Sorting, filters, row actions with confirmation and reordering through the kit DataTable and toolbar, not a hand-rolled table.

ui-page.crud-resource.summary: One generator for a record type's controller, request, ViewModel and index, form and show pages.

ui-page.workbench.summary: A bespoke workflow page beyond CRUD still gets route, controller, typed ViewModel, page and test from one skeleton.

ui-page.dashboard-widget.summary: Register a widget with its order and placement; never fork the kit dashboard page.

ui-page.auth-override.summary: Extend kit auth screens through their slots and link configuration instead of an app-owned copy.

ui-page.public-legal.summary: A sessionless public shell with config-driven product and legal links and markdown content.

ui-page.exhibit.summary: A per-visitor demo exhibit with capacity limits and a prune command.

ui-page.signed-guest.summary: A token-bound page for an unauthenticated recipient, served no-store, recording their decisions.

ui-page.error.summary: A branded Inertia error page for 4xx and 5xx responses.

ui-page.filament.summary: Use native Filament fields and relations by default; a custom field states its reason.

data-actions.document.summary: A frozen document rendered to PDF through one renderer contract.

data-actions.api-op.summary: An OpenAPI entry, controller and MCP mirror for each public, versioned API operation.

Per-person state outside a settings page
